title: PairRecoverResponse
description: Response to POST /api/v1/pair/recover with rotated bearer token.

token.description: Rotated opaque bearer token issued for the paired device

expires_in.description: Token lifetime in seconds. 0 means no automatic expiry.

device_id.description: Stable identifier assigned to the paired device

server_id.description: Stable identifier of the server that issued the token
